    The convex geometry of image closure #

    Section 4.3 of the manuscript, for an indecomposable skeleton σ of FGModuleCat R over a Noetherian and Artinian ring R whose indecomposable representatives have Artinian endomorphism rings (mod Λ for a finite-dimensional algebra Λ is the case of the manuscript).

    • (4.3) The image closure icl(S) = qcl(S) ∩ scl(S) on sets of representatives (iClosure).
    • Theorem 4.11. icl is a finitary convex geometry (iClosure_isFinitary, iClosure_isClosed_empty, iClosure_isAntiExchange) whose closed sets correspond to the image-closed subcategories (isImageClosed_iff_isClosed_indOf, imageClosedOrderIso).
    • Definition 4.12. Splitting projective and splitting injective objects of a subcategory (IsSplittingProjective, IsSplittingInjective).
    • Proposition 4.13 (not_mem_qClosure_sdiff_iff, not_mem_sClosure_sdiff_iff, extremePoints_iff_isImageClosed, extremePoints_iff_splitting).
    • Corollary 4.14. Meets and joins of image-closed subcategories (isGLB_iInf, isLUB_join); the unique minimal generating set of a finite image-closed subcategory (iClosure_splitting_eq, splitting_subset); covers add exactly one indecomposable (exists_sdiff_eq_singleton_of_covby, ncard_of_covby).

              Corollary 4.14(3): along a cover, the number of indecomposables grows by one; so for a representation-finite algebra the lattice of image-closed subcategories is graded by size.
